newsitem.title: EGYPT: Arab League meeting opens in Cairo.
newsitem.headline: Arab League meeting opens in Cairo.

text.p: An Arab League ministerial meeting opened in Cairo on Saturday with an agenda dominated by obstacles to Middle East peace.
Foreign ministers from the 22 Arab League members are also expected to discuss tension between Iraq and the United States.
The session opened with formal speeches by the outgoing chairman, Tunisian Foreign Minister Habib Ben Yahia, and by his successor, Ahmed Attaf of Algeria.
It then went into closed extraordinary session to hear Palestinian President Yasser Arafat report on his complaints against the Israeli government which took power in June.
